output.headline: This reimbursement looks consistent with how the org has handled EEG consumables for the headset build, and it's well within the filing window.

reasons.text: A very similar request, electrode gel and snap leads for the headset, was approved on P-18 with the treasurer calling them fine consumables. This request is the same kind of purchase at a comparable size.

C-05 asks for EEG consumables sized to one build cycle with no stockpiling. The order of electrode kits and gel matches the invoice and was placed because the build was blocked on them, so it reads as a single-cycle purchase.

It was filed [[S-days-since-purchase]] days after purchase, inside the C-08 window. It is also far below the C-06 threshold of [[S-threshold-C-06]], so the project lead and demo date requirement does not apply.

The board said recently that materials can be bought as needed this semester and that Arjun owns purchasing for the headset team. Project Hardware would still have [[S-line-remaining-after]] left after this.
